title: Practice 11: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **подходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of подходить: imperfective (perfective partner: подойти).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
**отведёте** — future tense (2nd person plural) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: The dog came running to her.
exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: Do you need a ride to school?
exercises.why: **подвезти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: подвозить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: I gave her a ride home.
exercises.why: **подвезла** — past tense (feminine) of подвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: подвозить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
